jobs.title: Sr. Director, HR Shared Services Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact\-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well\-being of you and those we serve – we care.


What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

  

  

**Job Summary**

  

  

The Sr. Director, HR Shared Services Strategy \& Transformation is responsible for shaping and enabling the future evolution of HR Shared Services.
  

Working in close partnership with the SVP of HR Services and VP of Employee Care, this leader will translate the HR Services vision into an actionable transformation strategy and roadmap, bringing together process reimagination, technology, AI and automation, employee experience, operational insights and change execution.
  

The role leads a small team of specialists supporting transformation, technology enablement, continuous improvement, service readiness, content strategy, reporting and governance. A critical part of the role is looking beyond how work is done today and identifying opportunities to simplify, automate, digitize, consolidate or eliminate work.
  

Success in this role requires someone who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels, partnering with senior leaders to define where HR Services needs to go while translating that vision into business cases, roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
  

  

The Strategy \& Transformation Team Enables HR Shared Services To:
  

* Deliver a great self\-service HR experience built on easy\-to\-use technology and employee\-centric HR content.
* Partner with the SVP of HR Services and VP of Employee Care to translate the HR Services vision into a prioritized transformation roadmap.
* Create and implement strategies to evolve HR Shared Services in response to changing business needs, M\&A, technology advancements and broader HR priorities.
* Reimagine HR processes and service delivery, challenging existing ways of working and identifying opportunities to simplify, automate, digitize, consolidate or eliminate work.
* Partner closely with Workforce Innovation to identify, prioritize and scale AI, automation and emerging technology opportunities that improve employee experience and unlock HR capacity.
* Equip HR Shared Services teams, including Employee Care representatives, with the information, tools and resources required to provide exceptional service when additional support is needed beyond self\-service.
* Partner to deliver a technology roadmap that improves employee experience and increases the effectiveness, efficiency and scalability of HR Shared Services.
* Drive continuous improvement across processes, technology and service delivery.
* Ensure Shared Services is prepared to absorb new and changing services resulting from HR transformation and broader business priorities.
* Provide governance for Shared Services, including budgeting, transformation prioritization, HR leadership alignment, scorecards and reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. HR Shared Services Strategy \& Transformation**


* Partner with the SVP of HR Services and VP of Employee Care to shape the future\-state strategy for HR Shared Services and translate that strategy into a clear, sequenced transformation roadmap.
* Own the approach for how HR Shared Services evolves to support HR and business transformation initiatives, including changes arising from M\&A, geographic expansion, new HR capabilities and evolving business requirements.
* Anticipate how changes in the business, HR priorities, technology and the external environment should influence the future service model.

**2\. Process Reimagination \& Workforce Innovation**


* Challenge existing processes and ways of working and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, digitize, consolidate or eliminate work.
* Work in close partnership with Workforce Innovation to translate HR Shared Services opportunities, employee pain points and operational challenges into potential solutions, establishing clear business requirements, expected outcomes and priorities.
* Build business cases, prioritize opportunities and help move transformation initiatives from concept through implementation and measurable impact.
* The expectation is to go beyond incremental process improvement and continually ask how work could be fundamentally redesigned.

**3\. AI, Digital \& Technology Strategy**


* Partner closely with the Product Manager in Workforce Innovation and HR Technology to shape and execute the HR Shared Services technology roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the broader Workforce Innovation strategy and the evolving needs of HR Services.
* Bring a strong understanding of HR Shared Services operations, employee needs and transformation priorities to jointly identify, prioritize and implement opportunities leveraging AI, automation, agentic capabilities and emerging technologies.
* Partner on the continued evolution of platforms such as ServiceNow and Workday to improve self\-service, increase resolution, simplify employee experiences and create greater efficiency and capacity across HR.
* Continuously evaluate how emerging technology can change how HR work is performed, including opportunities to automate, simplify or eliminate work rather than simply digitizing existing processes.

**4\. Employee Experience \& Self\-Service**


* Partner with the VP of Employee Care to continually improve the end\-to\-end employee HR support experience.
* Drive the strategy for HR knowledge, content and self\-service enablement, including the evolution of the HR portal and integration of knowledge and support across HR and McKesson

* Consumer lending, subprime credit, lease\-to\-own, wireless, car rental, or high\-velocity commission retail experience strongly preferred.

Explain plainly whether operating in person out of our Cambridge HQ plus heavy weekly road hours visiting branches across Ontario (zero remote/hybrid days, including extended pushes when stores need work) realistically fits your career goals.

jobs.title: Head of Regional Events, Canada
jobs.description:
Curate Group is a dynamic events and experiences company, creating unforgettable moments that bring people together. We specialise in unique, high\-quality live events \- from large scale festivals, immersive concerts, cultural experiences and corporate events partnering with some of the world’s most exciting brands.


One of our core event brands, Lumos Experiences, is one of the most distinctive live entertainment concepts, creating atmospheric candlelit musical concerts that transform unexpected spaces into something genuinely magical. We're growing fast, running multiple shows per week across new cities and countries and we're looking to invest in a highly organized **Head of Regional Events** to support our expansion and ongoing running of our shows.

  

The **Head of Regional Event Operations** owns the day\-to\-day performance of their assigned hub, overseeing bookings, marketing, operations, finance, sales and customer experience to ensure every show is profitable, well\-run and continuously improving. The role is focused on scaling and growing the region.
You are the senior local decision\-maker, accountable for performance, team alignment and execution and responsible for planning, people management and performance tracking to consistently deliver Lumos standards.


Working closely with HQ based in London, you will implement regional strategy and lead teams on the ground to deliver a seamless, five\-star experience at every Lumos show. The role starts hands\-on and quickly evolves into leading a growing regional team as the market scales, while retaining end\-to\-end ownership of regional operations.


Weekend availability is essential, as you will attend and oversee key events to uphold Lumos’ operational and brand standards.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES*** **Regional Leadership:** Own the performance and growth of Lumos Events in the region, acting as the senior on\-the\-ground decision\-maker and ensuring delivery aligns with company objectives.
* **Business Planning \& Growth:** In partnership with HQ, develop and execute regional business plans aligned to company targets, driving commercial performance, operational excellence and customer experience.
* **Strategy \& Performance Analysis:** Analyze ticket sales, pricing, customer data and event performance to inform strategy and work with HQ to translate insights into action.
* **Venue Partnerships:** Source, secure, negotiate and contract venues, acting as the primary liaison with venue partners and suppliers. *(This will transition to a dedicated Venue Partnerships hire within \~1 month).*
* **Event Delivery Leadership:** Oversee end\-to\-end planning and execution of regional events, ensuring seamless delivery across creative, operational and on\-site teams.
* **Team Leadership:** Recruit, build and lead a high\-performing events team, overseeing staffing, scheduling, onboarding and training to ensure consistency and reliability.
* **Training \& Development:** Develop training programmed, playbooks and operational tools to support scale, consistency and continuous improvement.
* **Operations \& Systems:** Build and improve processes, systems and logistics to streamline event delivery and support regional growth *(An Operations Manager would be hired in the first 3\-5 months to support on every day delivery)*
* **Production Oversight:** Manage production teams and technical partners to ensure flawless delivery of sound, lighting, staging and on\-site operations.
* **Budget \& Financial Control:** Own regional budgets, ensuring efficient spend while maintaining high\-quality delivery.
* **Reporting \& Insights:** Deliver regular performance reporting across KPIs, sales and customer feedback to drive ongoing improvement.
* **Market Awareness \& Innovation:** Stay close to industry trends and competitor activity, using insights to inform strategy and propose improvements.
* **Stakeholder Relationships:** Build strong relationships with internal teams, venues and external partners to ensure alignment and smooth execution.

 **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**  

* Proven experience in event operations, production or management. Ideally within the live entertainment or hospitality sectors.
* A natural self\-starter who thrives on responsibility and momentum.
* Confident in making decisions, even under pressure and always ready to find a solution.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to multitask.
* Excellent negotiation, communication and interpersonal skills.
* Budget management experience.
* Driver's license and flexibility to work some shows on weekends, travelling to various locations as needed.
* Proficiency in Google Suite, AI and team collaboration tools.

 **WHAT WE OFFER**  

* Salary: $90,000–$105,000 CAD per year, based on your experience and skills.
* Access to our discretionary annual bonus based on performance
* Covered travel expenses to shows
* 11 days annual leave, plus 9 public holidays and extra days off at Christmas
* An extra day of annual leave gifted for each year of service (up to an additional 3 days). Vacation entitlement will always meet or exceed Ontario Employment Standards Act minimums
* Your Birthday off
* Health benefits
* Group RRSP (Registered Retirement Savings Plan)
* Maternity and paternity leave policy
* A flexible hybrid\-working policy 3 days in the office and 2 at home
* Significant opportunities for personal growth and career progression as the business scales.

 **AI IN OUR HIRING PROCESS**
We use AI tools to help record and summarize interviews. AI is not used to screen applications, and all hiring decisions are made by our team.
